hardQuoteObservations.preregisteredQuote: Monjyayaki, Okonomiyaki (Japanese savory pancake), Izakaya (Japanese style tavern)
[2-Hour All You Can Drink] "Shio" - Seafood Delight Course -

This seafood course is a delight for fish lovers, featuring carefully selected ingredients from all over the country, with fresh seafood sourced daily from long-standing wholesale vendors at Toyosu Market. You will also enjoy the highest quality mentaiko that can only be tasted with this course, alongside our signature monja named after our restaurant, Koboreya. Additionally, savor our decadent okonomiyaki loaded with fluffy batter and luxurious scallops from Ohambe, and our exceptional yakisoba made with scallops, squid, clam, and pork belly, complemented by a special soy sauce.
[2-Hour All You Can Drink] "Kizuna" - Special Course for 2 People -

This is a special course called "Kizuna" available exclusively for two diners, allowing you to fully enjoy the flavors of Koboreya. We offer a combination of our signature items and those exclusive to this course. Delight in simplicity with our proud ingredients, including tempura bits from Michelin Bib Gourmand-rated Tempura Abe, and dashi made from Fukushimakatsu and pork backbones sourced from a long-established shop in Kyoto.
[2-Hour All You Can Drink] "Tsuki" - Tsukishima Enjoyment Course -

For those experiencing Tsukishima Monja for the first time, we highly recommend the "Koboreya" special course. Indulge in the classic Tsukishima-style Mentaiko Monja, featuring a savory sauce made with pork and Baby Star, a beloved treat since the Showa era. Enjoy the finest quality mentaiko sourced from Japan. Additionally, savor our special soy sauce yakisoba, made with chewy noodles, and a fluffy, carefully crafted okonomiyaki.
